primaryChecks.text: Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.
